title: Transfection of primary mouse T cells for stimulation-dependent cytokine enhancer assays
protocol: Coat 24-well plates with anti-CD3 plus anti-CD28.
Stimulate 1.0 x 10^6 purified naive CD4+ or CD8+ cells in 1 mL of appropriate medium.
Split cells by a ratio of 1:2 to 1:4 every 2-3 days for expansion.
Include neutralizing anti-cytokine antibodies in the first split as needed.
Omit antibodies but include cytokines in subsequent splits.
Maintain cell density between 0.5 - 2.5 x 10^6 cells per well.
Gently pipette up and down to resuspend cells, using plugged tips for splitting.
Monitor cells for blast morphology after 1-2 days of stimulation.
Collect cells for transfection at day 6 – 8 by gently pipetting each well’s contents up and down to resuspend the cells.
Wash wells with medium to capture all cells.
Centrifuge cells at 450xg for 7 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend cells in medium lacking IL-2.
Repeat centrifugation of cells in medium lacking IL-2.
Culture cells in tissue culture flasks at 37 °C in IMDM containing 10% FCS, penicillin and streptomycin for 5 hours prior to transfection.
Place the flask on ice for 1 hour.
Prepare Amaxa® Mouse T Cell Nucleofector Medium according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Aliquot 5.0 μg TK-pRL and 20.0 μg of the desired Ifng-pGL constructs into a sterile 1.5mL eppendorf tube per transfection.
Prepare 1.5 mL cell recovery medium per transfection by adding 10 μL/mL Amaxa® Component B to Mouse T Cell Nucleofector Medium.
Aliquot 1.5mL/well of the prepared cell recovery medium in a 24-well plate.
Equilibrate the plate at 37°C, 5%CO2 for at least 30 minutes before transfection.
Prewarm Mouse T Cell Amaxa® Nucleofector Solution to room temperature 15-20 minutes before transfection.
Count and verify the viability of cells by standard procedures.
Centrifuge cells at 90xg for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove all supernatant and gently flick pellet to loosen cells.
Resuspend cells gently in room temperature Amaxa® Mouse T Cell Nucleofector Solution to a final concentration of ~5.0x10^6 cells/100 μL.
Transfer 100 μL cell suspension into Eppendorf tubes containing 25 μg DNA (5.0 μg TK-pRL plus 20.0 μg of the desired Ifng-pGL constructs).
Mix the cell suspension with the DNA.
Transfer the mixture into an Amaxa® Nucleofector cuvette, being careful to avoid air bubbles and ensure the suspension is at the bottom of the cuvette chamber.
Select the Amaxa ® Nucleofector X-01 program.
Insert the cuvette and press X to transfect.
Add ~500 μL of pre-warmed medium from the equilibrated 24-well plate to the cuvette with a supplied micropipette.
Gently remove cells to the plate, being careful to remove all debris and volume.
Press X to reset Amaxa ® Nucleofector and repeat for remaining samples.
Allow cells to recover at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for 4 hours.
Prepare the 48-well plates during the last 15 minutes of recovery.
Add 100 μL of Amaxa ® Nucleofector Medium to wells for unstimulated or anti-CD3 plus anti-CD28 samples.
For IL-12 plus IL-18 stimulation, add 100 μL of medium containing 5 μg/mL IL-12 and 5 μg/mL IL-18 to the appropriate wells.
Gently mix cells using a standard micropipette and plugged tips, avoiding air bubbles.
Transfer 345 μL of cell suspension to each of four wells for stimulation (unstimulated, anti-CD3 plus anti-CD28, IL-12 plus IL-18, or all stimuli combined).
Harvest cells 3-6 hours after stimulation by washing wells with 1 mL PBS.
Transfer the cell suspension into 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes and spin at 1400 rpm for 5 min, 4 °C.
Gently flick the cell pellet and resuspend cells in 50 μL 1x Passive Lysis Buffer (PLB).
Mix briefly by gentle vortexing.
Set samples on a rocker for 10 minutes (~60 rpm) at room temperature.
Quick spin to collect sample contents at the bottom of the tube.
Store sample lysates at -80°C without loss of activity for >1 month.
Perform luciferase analysis using 20 μL of cell lysate as directed by the Dual-Luciferase kit manufacturer's protocol.
